Akshita Kothari

Financial Markets Operations Analyst | Reconciliation | Trade Lifecycle | NAV Validation

Financial markets professional with experience in cash & position reconciliation, NAV validation, and portfolio performance analytics across global investment portfolios. Proven ability to maintain 99%+ accuracy in high-volume environments, resolve complex breaks within T+1 timeline, and support valuation and reporting processes. Hands-on expertise in Aladdin, FactSet, Lipper, PAM and Markit with a strong foundation in trade lifecycle, fund accounting, and operational risk controls.

Phone: +91 7021185101 | Email: akshitakothari2310@gmail.com LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/akshita-kothari-b0089a204

➢ Profile Summary

Experienced in multi-asset cash & position reconciliation, ensuring accurate portfolio records and timely exception resolution with hands on expertise in using Aladdin, PAM & Markit

Strong understanding of NAV validation, portfolio valuation, and financial reporting workflows • Proven ability to investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks within T+1 SLAs through coordination with custodians and internal teams

Hands-on expertise in performance measurement, attribution, and benchmarking using FactSet and Lipper • Adept at working within global control frameworks, ensuring compliance, data accuracy, and operational efficiency

Collaborative team player with experience supporting fund managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams

➢ Core Competencies

Cash & Position Reconciliation | Custodian Reconciliation | IBOR & ABOR Reconciliation • Break Resolution & Exception Management | NAV Validation • Trade Lifecycle & Corporate Actions | Fund Accounting • Stakeholder Coordination | High-Volume Operations • Data Governance & Control Frameworks | Operational Risk Management

➢ Technical Skills

Financial Systems: Aladdin (BlackRock), Portfolio Accounting Manager (PAM), FactSet, Lipper, Markit • Data & Reporting: Advanced Excel ,MS PowerPoint, MS Word, Outlook • Other Skills: Basic SQL (data extraction & reconciliation support)

➢ Work Experience

Oracle Processing Services Limited Associate Transaction Processing Consultant | Jun 2025 – Present

Executed daily multi-asset cash and position reconciliations across financial instruments such as Cash, Equities, Bonds, STIF/Sweep funds, Derivatives, Bank Loans, Collateral instruments, and OTC portfolios in high volume environments with 99%+ accuracy • Validated trade and income activity including dividends, interest, and corporate action events, FX transactions,

bank loans in books & records

•

Investigated and resolved complex reconciliation breaks within T+1 timeline, coordinating with custodians, brokers, and middle-office teams

Supported end-of-day NAV and valuation validation by reviewing reconciled data and escalating exceptions • Monitored end-to-end trade lifecycle including trade capture, settlement validation, and exception handling • Operated within global procedures and control frameworks, ensuring compliance and risk mitigation • Contributed to process improvement initiatives by identifying recurring breaks and supporting root cause analysis (RCA)

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure timely closure of exceptions and reporting accuracy

Atos Syntel, Mumbai Performance Analyst | May 2024 – Jun 2025

Delivered performance measurement, attribution, and benchmarking analysis for equity portfolios using FactSet and Lipper

Reconciled portfolio performance data and valuation inputs, ensuring accurate reporting outputs • Assessed and validated corporate action impacts on portfolio performance • Supported fund managers, RFP teams, and stakeholders with performance insights and analytics • Managed multiple portfolios simultaneously while maintaining strict quality and control standards

➢ Key Achievements

Best Debutant Award – Recognized for outstanding performance (Nov 2025) • Spot Award – Awarded multiple times for delivering high-quality reconciliation outputs and meeting tight deadlines (Jun 2025, Oct 2025, Dec 2025)

Smile Award (Client Appreciation) – Awarded twice for maintaining high accuracy and ensuring timely

resolution of reconciliation breaks (Oct 2025, Dec 2025)

Champ Award – Recognized for quality performance and dedication towards work (Nov 2024)

➢ Education

Bachelor of Accounting & Finance (BAF)

K.P.B. Hinduja College of Commerce | 2024 | CGPA: 9.55

Mithibai College of Commerce | 2020 | 91.54% • K.E.S Hans Bhugra High School | 2018 | 93.40%

➢ Certifications

NISM Series VII: Securities Operations and Risk Management • NISM Series VIII: Equity Derivatives • Advanced Excel Certification • Tally ERP 9 & Prime with GST – Advanced Level • IT-ITES (Assistant Computer Operator)

Personal Details

Date of Birth: 23rd October 2002

Address: Santacruz, Mumbai
